# Pictory Pricing in 2026: Is It Worth Paying For?

Pictory sells several plans, and the right one depends on how much you use it. Below is the current lineup, what you get at each tier, and who should (or shouldn't) upgrade. *Prices are approximate and change often — confirm on the official site before buying.*

## Pictory Plans at a Glance

| Plan | Price | What You Get |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Standard | $19/mo | 30 videos/mo |
| Premium | $39/mo | 60 videos/mo |
| Teams | $99/mo | shared workspace |

## Which Plan Should You Pick?

- **Free / trial:** best for testing the waters. marketers turning blogs into video can try it without risk.

- **Mid tier ($39/mo):** the sweet spot for most individuals who use Pictory regularly.

- **Top tier ($99/mo):** for power users and teams that need the extra limits or seats.


## Is Pictory Worth Paying For?

If the text-to-video tool is central to your work — marketers turning blogs into video — the paid plan pays for itself quickly. If you only need occasional help, the free tier or a cheaper alternative may be enough.

## Frequently Asked Questions

### How much does Pictory cost?

Pictory starts at $19/mo and goes up to $99/mo on the top tier. Exact pricing changes, so check the official site.

### Does Pictory have a free plan?

It offers a free trial — you can test it before paying.

### Is Pictory worth the money?

For its core audience (marketers turning blogs into video), yes. Lighter users may be fine on a free or cheaper alternative.
